_comment: Each profile is a clone of its base_scheme. Only add settings you want to OVERRIDE from the base. Leave settings empty to use the base scheme values as-is.

_settings_help.hibernate: 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled. Applied only when profile is activated, not at sync time
_settings_help.wifi_power_save: 0 = max performance, 1 = low power, 2 = medium power, 3 = max power save
_settings_help.lid/button actions: 0 = do nothing, 1 = sleep, 2 = hibernate, 3 = shut down

profiles.name: Performance
profiles.description: Clone of High Performance defaults. Add overrides in settings if needed.

profiles.name: Balanced
profiles.description: Clone of Balanced defaults. Add overrides in settings if needed.

profiles.name: Battery Saver
profiles.description: Clone of Power Saver defaults. Add overrides in settings if needed.
